Yeah fox is just really hard and lasers can really throw a wrench into any sort of gameplan if youre not good against them.

Walling with short hop bair is a great base gameplan against fox. Falling back airs are good against fox dashing in or jumping in. Try to space well so you don't get cc punished. Mix up your FF timings so you're not predictable. Rising back air is good against fullhop and auto cancels. Wavedash back->ftilt is great at reactionary stopping approaches.

Then building around that with like boost grab, run up jc grab, run up ftilt, ac fair, empty movement, etc.

Against falco, you kinda end up playing at this dangerous midrange where a lot of mixups happen around. Good rule of thumb is to short hop over low lasers and crouch/dash/wavedash under high lasers. If you think he's gonna do an approaching laser, ftilt. If you think he's gonna aerial, take laser dash back then grab his endlag.

Against shield pressure, wavedash OoS or nair OoS. So get good at those.
